`commonmark-0.31.2.json` contains the unmodified examples from the
[CommonMark 0.31.2 specification](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json)
by John MacFarlane and contributors. The specification is licensed under
[Creative Commons CC-BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
The tests compare the optimized adapter with the pinned Marked configuration;
they do not assert complete conformance of GFM output to CommonMark's expected HTML.

`pixel.png`: generated 1 × 1 pixel PNG, 68 bytes. Other fixtures are project test data.
